test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If x% of 190 is 15 less than (x + 10)% of 180, then (x + 30)% of 90 is what per cent more than x% of 150?
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question-

⇒ xover100 × 190 + 15 = (x + 10)over100 × 180

⇒ 190x + 1500 = 180x + 1800

⇒ 10x = 300

⇒ x = 30 

Substituting the value of x in the equation-

(x + 30)% of 90
